title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB/13th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Sony FeCr90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Well‑mastered matrix recording with clear sound; a mellow second set highlighted by Scarlet > Fire and a beautiful Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The tape, captured on a Sony TC‑D5M with close‑mic placement and expertly mixed by Charlie Miller, delivers a clean, balanced matrix sound that benefits from a high‑resolution 24‑bit/96 kHz version. Musically the show shines in its second set – subdued yet moving performances of Scarlet > Fire, Estimated Prophet > He's Gone, and an especially mellow Morning Dew – while the first set is seen as forgettable by some listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Three five‑star reviews praise both the performance and the high‑quality matrix mix; one three‑star review notes a mediocre first set, leading to an overall strong but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced matrix mix with high‑resolution mastering (24‑bit/96 kHz). Reviewers note Charlie Miller’s masterful work; no major dropouts or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered forgettable; second set flows smoothly with moody, subdued playing and strong keyboard/drum interplay.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboard work is highlighted, especially in the drum/keyboard sections of the second set.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drums (Bill Kreutzmann) are praised for their great interplay with Brent’s keyboards.
